name: Jean-Hilaire Aubame
contribution: A Gabonese politician active during both the colonial and independence periods.
legacy: This person was also a leader in solving African problems, particularly developing the Gabonese standard of living and planning urban sites.

checks.lead: Jean-Hilaire Aubame (10 November 1912 – 18 August 1989) was a Gabonese politician active during both the colonial and independence periods. The French journalist Pierre Péan said that Aubame's training "as a practicing Catholic and a customs official helped to make him an integrated man, one of whom political power was not an end in itself."
